description: Source code for quantized linear prepacking functions in PyTorch, including support for various backends like FBGEMM, QNNPACK, and ONEDNN. Defines functions for prepacking weights, handling different quantization schemes, and registering operators.

classes.name: QLinearPackWeightInt8
classes.description: Handles packing of int8 quantized linear weights depending on the backend engine.

classes.name: QLinearPackWeightFp16
classes.description: Handles packing of FP16 quantized linear weights depending on the backend engine.

classes.name: QLinearPackWeightInt8Legacy
classes.description: Legacy support for int8 weight packing, currently not supported.

classes.name: QLinearPackWeightFp16Legacy
classes.description: Legacy support for FP16 weight packing, currently not supported.

classes.name: QLinearPackWeightInt8Onednn
classes.description: Handles ONEDNN-specific weight packing for int8 weights.

classes.name: QLinearPackWeightFp16Onednn
classes.description: Handles ONEDNN-specific weight packing for FP16 weights.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeight::prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs a weight tensor for quantized linear operations using FBGEMM.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeightsQnnp::prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs a weight tensor for quantized linear operations using QNNPACK.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeightFp16::prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs a weight tensor for FP16 quantized linear operations using FBGEMM.

methods.name: PackedLinearWeightsOnednn::prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs a weight tensor for ONEDNN backend.

methods.name: pack_weight_to_onednn_tensor
methods.description: Converts a weight tensor into an ONEDNN-compatible tensor format.

methods.name: pack_weight_to_fp16_onednn_tensor
methods.description: Converts a weight tensor into an FP16 ONEDNN-compatible tensor format.
